And they fell on their faces and said, “God, the God of the spirits of all flesh, will one man sin and you be angry against all the congregation?”
And Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
“Speak to the congregation, saying, ‘Be taken up from around to the dwelling of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram.’”
And Moses rose and went to Dathan and Abiram, and the elders of Israel went after him.
And he spoke to the congregation, saying, “Turn aside, please, from upon the tents of these wicked men, and do not touch all that is to them, lest you be swept away in all their sins.”

And they were taken up from upon the dwelling of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram, from around, and Dathan and Abiram went out, standing at the opening of their tents, and their wives and their sons and their children.
And Moses said, “By this you will know that Yahweh has sent me to do all these works, that they are not from my heart:
If as the death of every man these die, and the oversight of every man is counted upon them, Yahweh did not send me.
But if Yahweh creates a creation, and the ground opens its mouth and swallows them and all that is to them, and they go down living to Sheol, then you will know that these men spurned Yahweh.”
And it happened, when he finished to speak all these words, that the ground that was under them was split open,
and the earth opened its mouth and swallowed them and their houses and every man who was to Korah and all the property,
and they went down, they and all that was to them, living to Sheol, and the earth covered over them, and they perished from the midst of the assembly.
And all Israel who was around them fled to their voice, for they said, “Lest the earth swallow us!”
And fire went out from with Yahweh, and it ate the 250 men presenting the incense.
And Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
“Say to Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, and he shall raise the censers from between the burning, and scatter the fire beyond, for they are holy.

The censers of these ones sinning against their lives, and they shall make them hammered sheets of thin plates, plating for the altar, for they presented them to the face of Yahweh, and they are holy, and they shall be for a sign for the sons of Israel.”
And Eleazar the priest took the censers of bronze that the ones being burned had presented, and they hammered them as plating for the altar,

a memorial for the sons of Israel, so that a strange man, who is not from the seed of Aaron, shall not come near to cause incense to become smoke to the face of Yahweh, and he shall not be like Korah and like his congregation, just as Yahweh spoke in the hand of Moses to him.
And all the congregation of the sons of Israel murmured from the next day against Moses and against Aaron, saying, “You, you killed the people of Yahweh!”
And it happened, when the congregation assembled against Moses and against Aaron, that they turned to the tent of meeting, and behold, the cloud covered it, and the glory of Yahweh appeared.
And Moses and Aaron went to the face of the tent of meeting,
and Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
“Lift yourselves up from the midst of this congregation, and I shall finish them according to a moment.” And they fell on their faces.

And Moses said to Aaron, “Take the censer, and put fire on it from upon the altar, and set incense, and bring it quickly to the congregation, and make atonement for them, for the wrath has gone out from to the face of Yahweh. The plague has begun.”
And Aaron took, just as Moses spoke, and he ran to the midst of the assembly. And behold, the plague had begun among the people. And he put the incense, and he made atonement for the people.
And he stood between the ones dying and between the ones living. And the plague was restrained.
And the ones dying by the plague were 14,700, besides the ones dying on account of the matter of Korah.
And Aaron returned to Moses, to the opening of the tent of meeting, and the plague was restrained.
And Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

“Speak to the sons of Israel, and take from with them a staff, a staff for a house of a father, from with all their leaders for the house of their fathers, 12 staffs. A man, his name you shall write on his staff.
And the name of Aaron you shall write on the staff of Levi, for one staff is for the head of the house of their fathers.
And you shall make them rest in the tent of meeting to the face of the Testimony, where I congregate with you there.
And it will be that the man whom I choose, his staff will sprout. And I will cause to subside from upon me the murmurings of the sons of Israel, which they are murmuring against you.”

And Moses spoke to the sons of Israel, and all their leaders gave to him a staff for one leader, a staff for one leader, for the house of their fathers, 12 staffs. And the staff of Aaron was in the midst of their staffs.
And Moses made the staffs rest to the face of Yahweh in the tent of the Testimony.

And it happened from the next day that Moses came to the tent of the Testimony, and behold, the staff of Aaron for the house of Levi had sprouted. And it brought out a blossom and it blossomed a flower, and it ripened almonds.
And Moses brought out all the staffs from to the face of Yahweh to all the sons of Israel. And they saw, and they took, a man his staff.

And Yahweh said to Moses, “Return the staff of Aaron to the face of the Testimony for keeping, for a sign for the sons of rebellion. And you shall finish their murmurings from upon me, and they shall not die.”
And Moses did. Just as Yahweh had commanded him, thus he did.
And the sons of Israel said to Moses, saying, “Behold, we expire! We perish; all of us perish!
Everyone coming near, the one coming near to the Dwelling of Yahweh, will die. Shall we finish to expire?”

And Yahweh said to Aaron, “You and your sons and the house of your father with you shall lift up the iniquity of the holy place, and you and your sons with you shall lift up the iniquity of your priesthood.

And also bring near with you your brothers, the tribe of Levi, the tribe of your father, and they shall be joined to you and shall minister to you. And you and your sons with you shall be to the face of the tent of the Testimony.
And they shall keep your keeping and the keeping of all the tent. Only to the vessels of the holy place and to the altar they shall not come near, so they will not die, both they and you.
And they shall be joined to you, and they shall keep the keeping of the tent of meeting for all the service of the tent. And a stranger shall not come near to you.
And you shall keep the keeping of the holy place and the keeping of the altar, and there shall not be again wrath against the sons of Israel.
And I, behold, I have taken your brothers the Levites from the midst of the sons of Israel, a gift for you, given to Yahweh, to serve the service of the tent of meeting.

And you and your sons with you shall keep your priesthood for every matter of the altar and for inside the veil, and you shall serve. I give your priesthood as a service of a gift. And the stranger who comes near shall be put to death.”

And Yahweh spoke to Aaron, “And I, behold, I have given to you the keeping of my contributions, for all the holy things of the sons of Israel. To you I have given them for a portion and to your sons for a statute of eternity.

This shall be for you from the holy thing of the holy things, from the fire: every offering of theirs, for every grain offering of theirs and for every sin offering of theirs and for every guilt offering of theirs which they return to me. It is a holy thing of holy things for you and for your sons.
In the holy of holies you shall eat it. Every male shall eat it. It shall be holy for you.

And this is for you: the contribution of their gift, for all the raised offerings of the sons of Israel. To you I have given them and to your sons and to your daughters with you for a statute of eternity. Every clean one in your house shall eat it.
All the fat of the oil and all the fat of the new wine and grain, their firstfruits which they give to Yahweh, to you I have given them.
The firstfruits of all that is in their land which they bring to Yahweh shall be for you. Every clean one in your house shall eat it.
Every devoted thing in Israel shall be for you.

Every opener of the womb for all flesh which they present to Yahweh, among the man and among the animal, shall be for you. Only redeeming you shall redeem the firstborn of the man, and the firstborn of the unclean animal you shall redeem.
And his redeemed ones from a son of a month you shall redeem by your valuation, silver of five shekels, by the shekel of the holy place (it is 20 gerahs).

Only a firstborn of an ox or a firstborn of a sheep or a firstborn of a goat you shall not redeem; they are holy. You shall splash their blood on the altar, and you shall cause their fat to become smoke, a gift for a scent of pleasing to Yahweh.
And their flesh shall be for you; like the breast of the raised offering and like the right thigh, it shall be for you.

All the contributions of the holy things that the sons of Israel raise to Yahweh I have given to you and to your sons and to your daughters with you for a statute of eternity. It is a covenant of salt of eternity to the face of Yahweh, for you and for your seed with you.”
And Yahweh said to Aaron, “In their land you shall not inherit, and a portion shall not be for you in their midst. I am your portion and your inheritance in the midst of the sons of Israel.
And to the sons of Levi, behold, I have given every tithe in Israel for an inheritance, in exchange for their service which they are serving, the service of the tent of meeting.
And the sons of Israel shall not again come near to the tent of meeting to lift up sin, to die.

And the Levite, he shall serve the service of the tent of meeting, and they shall bear their iniquity. It is a statute of eternity for your generations, and in the midst of the sons of Israel they shall not inherit an inheritance.

For the tithe of the sons of Israel, which they raise to Yahweh as a contribution, I have given to the Levites for an inheritance. Therefore I have said to them that in the midst of the sons of Israel they shall not inherit an inheritance.”
And Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

“And to the Levites you shall speak, and you shall say to them, ‘When you take from with the sons of Israel the tithe which I have given to you from with them for your inheritance, then you shall raise from it a contribution of Yahweh, a tithe from the tithe.
And your contribution shall be reckoned to you as the grain from the threshing floor and as the fullness from the winepress.
Thus you shall raise, you also, the contribution of Yahweh from all your tithes which you take from with the sons of Israel, and you shall give from it the contribution of Yahweh to Aaron the priest.
From all your gifts you shall raise every contribution of Yahweh, from all its fat, its holy thing from it.’
And you shall say to them, ‘When you lift up its fat from it, then it shall be reckoned to the Levites like produce of a threshing floor and like produce of a winepress.
And you shall eat it in every place, you and your house, for it is a wage for you in exchange for your service in the tent of meeting.
And you shall not lift up sin upon it when you raise its fat from it. And the holy things of the sons of Israel you shall not profane, and you shall not die.’”
And Yahweh spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

“This is the statute of the law that Yahweh has commanded, saying, ‘Speak to the sons of Israel, and they shall take to you a perfect red cow in which there is no blemish, on which a yoke has not gone up.
And you shall give it to Eleazar the priest, and he shall bring it out to the outside of the camp, and he shall slaughter it to his face.
And Eleazar the priest shall take from its blood with his finger, and he shall sprinkle from its blood to the front of the face of the tent of meeting seven times.
And he shall burn the cow to his eyes; its skin and its flesh and its blood, with its dung, he shall burn.
And the priest shall take wood of cedar and hyssop and scarlet of worm, and he shall throw to the midst of the burning of the cow.
And the priest shall wash his clothes, and he shall bathe his flesh in the water, and after he shall come to the camp. And the priest shall be unclean until the evening.
And the one burning it shall wash his clothes in the water, and he shall bathe his flesh in the water, and he shall be unclean until the evening.

And a clean man shall gather the ashes of the cow and make them rest from outside to the camp in a clean place. And it shall be for the congregation of the sons of Israel for keeping, for water of impurity. It is a sin offering.

And the one gathering the ashes of the cow shall wash his clothes, and he shall be unclean until the evening. And it shall be for the sons of Israel and for the sojourner, the one sojourning in their midst, for a statute of eternity.
The one touching a dying one for every person of a man shall be unclean seven days.
He shall purify himself with it on the third day and on the seventh day. He will be clean. And if he does not purify himself on the third day and on the seventh day, he will not be clean.

Every one touching a dying one in the person of the man that dies, and he does not purify himself, he has made the Dwelling of Yahweh unclean. And that person shall be cut off from Israel, for water of impurity was not splashed on him. He shall be unclean; his uncleanness is still on him.
This is the law: a man, when he dies in a tent, every one coming to the tent and everyone who is in the tent shall be unclean seven days.
And every opened vessel on which there is no cover of cord, it is unclean.
And everyone who touches on the face of the field a slain one of the sword or a dying one or a bone of a man or a grave shall be unclean seven days.
And they shall take for the unclean one from the dust of the burning of the sin offering, and he shall put living water on it into a vessel.

And he shall take hyssop, and a clean man shall dip it in the water, and he shall sprinkle on the tent and on all the vessels and on the persons who were there, and on the one touching the bone or the slain one or the dying one or the grave.

And the clean one shall sprinkle on the unclean one on the third day and on the seventh day. And he shall purify him on the seventh day, and he shall wash his clothes and bathe in the water, and he will be clean in the evening.

And a man who is unclean and does not purify himself, that person shall be cut off from the midst of the assembly, for he has made the holy place of Yahweh unclean. Water of impurity was not splashed on him; he is unclean.

And it shall be for them for a statute of eternity. And the one sprinkling the water of the impurity shall wash his clothes, and the one touching the water of the impurity shall be unclean until the evening.
And everything that the unclean one touches shall be unclean, and the person touching it shall be unclean until the evening.’”
And the sons of Israel, all the congregation, came to the wilderness of Zin in the first month, and the people dwelt at Kadesh. And Miriam died there, and she was buried there.
And there was no water for the congregation, and they assembled against Moses and against Aaron.
And the people contended with Moses, and they said, saying, “If only we had expired when our brothers expired to the face of Yahweh!
And why have you brought the assembly of Yahweh to this wilderness to die there, we and our livestock?
And why did you bring us up from Egypt to bring us to this evil place? It is not a place of seed and fig and vine and pomegranate, and there is no water to drink!”
And Moses and Aaron went from the face of the assembly to the opening of the tent of meeting, and they fell on their faces. And the glory of Yahweh appeared to them.
And Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

“Take the staff and assemble the congregation, you and Aaron your brother, and you shall speak to the rock to their eyes, and it will give its water. And you shall bring out for them water from the rock, and you shall make the congregation and their livestock drink.”
And Moses took the staff from before the face of Yahweh, just as he commanded him.
And Moses and Aaron assembled the assembly to the face of the rock, and he said to them, “Please hear, the rebellious ones! From this rock shall we bring out water for you?”
And Moses raised his hand, and he struck the rock with his staff two times. And much water came out, and the congregation drank and their livestock.

And Yahweh said to Moses and to Aaron, “Because you did not believe in me to consecrate me to the eyes of the sons of Israel, therefore you will not bring this assembly to the land that I have given to them.”
They are the waters of Meribah, where the sons of Israel contended with Yahweh, and he showed himself to be holy in them.
And Moses sent messengers from Kadesh to the king of Edom: “Thus says your brother Israel: ‘You, you know all of the hardship that has found us.
And our fathers went down to Egypt, and we dwelled in Egypt many days, and the Egyptians did evil to us and to our fathers.
And we cried out to Yahweh, and he heard our voice, and he sent a messenger, and he brought us out from Egypt. And behold, we are in Kadesh, a city of the edge of your border.

Please let us pass over in your land. We will not pass over in a field or in a vineyard, and we will not drink water of a well. We will go on the way of the king. We will not turn aside right or left until when we have passed over your border.’”
And Edom said to him, “You shall not pass over in me, lest with the sword I come out to meet you.”
And the sons of Israel said to him, “On the highway we will go up. And if we drink your water, I and my livestock, then I will give its price. Only, there is no matter, let me pass over on my feet.”
And he said, “You shall not pass over.” And Edom came out to meet him with a heavy people and with a strong hand.
And Edom refused to give Israel to pass over in his border. And Israel turned aside from upon him.
And they set out from Kadesh, and the sons of Israel, all the congregation, came to Mount Hor.
And Yahweh said to Moses and to Aaron at Mount Hor, on the border of the land of Edom, saying,
“Aaron will be gathered to his peoples, for he will not come to the land that I have given to the sons of Israel, because you rebelled against my mouth at the waters of Meribah.
Take Aaron and Eleazar his son and bring them up Mount Hor.
And strip Aaron of his clothes and clothe Eleazar his son with them. And Aaron will be gathered and will die there.”
And Moses did just as Yahweh commanded. And they went up to Mount Hor to the eyes of all the congregation.
And Moses stripped Aaron of his clothes and clothed Eleazar his son with them. And Aaron died there on the top of the mountain. And Moses and Eleazar went down from the mountain.
And all the congregation saw that Aaron expired. And all the house of Israel wept for Aaron 30 days.
And the Canaanite, the king of Arad, the one dwelling in the Negev, heard that Israel had come the way of the Atharim, and he fought against Israel, and he took captive from him a captive.
And Israel vowed a vow to Yahweh, and they said, “If giving, you give this people into my hand, then I will devote their cities to destruction.”
And Yahweh listened to the voice of Israel, and he gave the Canaanite, and he devoted them and their cities to destruction. And he called the name of the place Hormah.
And they set out from Mount Hor by the way of the Sea of Reeds to go around the land of Edom. And the soul of the people was short on the way,

and the people spoke against God and against Moses, “Why have you brought us up from Egypt to die in the wilderness? For there is no bread and there is no water, and our soul loathes the worthless bread.”
And Yahweh sent among the people the serpents, the fiery ones, and they bit the people, and many people from Israel died.

And the people came to Moses and said, “We have sinned, for we spoke against Yahweh and against you. Pray to Yahweh, and let him remove from upon us the serpent.” And Moses prayed on behalf of the people.
And Yahweh said to Moses, “Make for yourself a fiery one and put it on a banner, and it will be that all the bitten ones will see it, and he will live.”
And Moses made a serpent of bronze, and he put it on the banner. And it was that if the serpent bit a man and he looked to the serpent of the bronze, then he lived.
And the sons of Israel set out, and they camped at Oboth.
And they set out from Oboth, and they camped at Iye Abarim in the wilderness that is upon the face of Moab, from the rising of the sun.
From there they set out, and they camped at Wadi Zered.
From there they set out, and they camped from across Arnon, which is in the wilderness that goes out from the border of the Amorite. For Arnon is the border of Moab, between Moab and the Amorite.

Therefore it is said in the Book of the Wars of Yahweh,
“Waheb in Suphah
and the wadis of Arnon,

and the slope of the wadis
that stretches out to the seat of Ar
and leans to the border of Moab.”
And from there to Beer. It is the well where Yahweh said to Moses, “Gather the people, and I will give water to them.”

Then Israel sang this song:
“Go up, well!
Sing to it!

A well, princes excavated it,
the nobles of the people dug it,
with a scepter, with their staffs.”
And from the wilderness to Mattanah,
and from Mattanah to Nahaliel, and from Nahaliel to Bamoth,
and from Bamoth to the valley that is in the field of Moab, the head of the Pisgah, and it looks down upon the face of the wasteland.
And Israel sent messengers to Sihon, the king of the Amorites, saying,
“Let me pass over in your land. We will not turn aside into a field or into a vineyard. We will not drink water of a well. On the way of the king we will go until when we pass over your border.”
And Sihon did not give Israel to pass over in his border, and Sihon gathered all his people and went out to meet Israel toward the wilderness. And he came to Jahaz, and he fought against Israel.
And Israel struck him to the mouth of the sword and possessed his land from Arnon as far as Jabbok, as far as the sons of Ammon. For the border of the sons of Ammon was strong.
And Israel took all these cities, and Israel dwelled in all the cities of the Amorite, in Heshbon and in all its daughters.
For Heshbon, it was the city of Sihon, the king of the Amorite, and he had fought against the former king of Moab, and he had taken all his land from his hand as far as Arnon.

Therefore the ones speaking in parables say,
“Come to Heshbon!
Let it be built and be established,
the city of Sihon!

For a fire went out from Heshbon,
a flame from the city of Sihon.
It consumed Ar of Moab,
the lords of the high places of Arnon.

Woe to you, Moab!
You have perished, people of Chemosh!
He has given his sons as fugitives
and his daughters in the captivity,
to a king of Amorite, Sihon.

And we shot them.
Heshbon has perished as far as Dibon.
And we made desolate as far as Nophah,
which is as far as Medeba.”
And Israel dwelled in the land of the Amorite.
And Moses sent to spy out Jazer, and they captured its daughters and dispossessed the Amorite who was there.
And they turned and went up the way of the Bashan. And Og, the king of the Bashan, went out to meet them, he and all his people, to the battle at Edrei.

And Yahweh said to Moses, “Do not fear him, for into your hand I have given him and all his people and his land. And you shall do to him as you did to Sihon, the king of the Amorite, who was dwelling in Heshbon.”
And they struck him and his sons and all his people until not a survivor remained for him, and they possessed his land.
And the sons of Israel set out, and they camped in the plains of Moab, from across to Jordan at Jericho.
And Balak the son of Zippor saw all that Israel had done to the Amorite.
And Moab was very afraid from the face of the people, because it was many. And Moab felt dread from the face of the sons of Israel.
And Moab said to the elders of Midian, “Now the assembly will lick up all around us, as the ox licks up the greenery of the field.” And Balak the son of Zippor was the king of Moab at that time.

And he sent messengers to Balaam the son of Beor, to Pethor, which is on the River, the land of the sons of his people, to call for him, saying, “Behold, a people has come out from Egypt. Behold, it has covered the eye of the land, and it is dwelling in front of me.

And now, please come, curse this people for me, for it is mightier than I. Perhaps I will be able to strike against it, and I will drive it out from the land. For I know that whom you bless is blessed, and whom you curse is cursed.”
And the elders of Moab and the elders of Midian went, and divinations were in their hand. And they came to Balaam and spoke to him the words of Balak.
And he said to them, “Lodge here tonight, and I will return to you a word, just as Yahweh speaks to me.” And the princes of Moab dwelled with Balaam.
And God came to Balaam and said, “Who are these men with you?”
And Balaam said to God, “Balak the son of Zippor, the king of Moab, sent to me,
‘Behold, the people coming out from Egypt, and it has covered the eye of the land. Now come, curse it for me. Perhaps I will be able to fight against it and drive it out.’”
And God said to Balaam, “You shall not go with them. You shall not curse the people, for it is blessed.”
And Balaam rose in the morning and said to the princes of Balak, “Go to your land, for Yahweh has refused to give me to go with you.”
And the princes of Moab rose and came to Balak and said, “Balaam refused to come with us.”
And Balak added again to send princes, more numerous and more honored than these.
And they came to Balaam and said to him, “Thus says Balak the son of Zippor, ‘Please, do not be withheld from coming to me,
for honoring, I will honor you greatly, and all that you say to me I will do. And please come, curse this people for me.’”

And Balaam answered and said to the servants of Balak, “If Balak gives to me the fullness of his house, silver and gold, I will not be able to pass over the mouth of Yahweh my God, to do small or great.
And now, please, you also dwell in this tonight, and I will know what Yahweh will add to speak with me.”
And God came to Balaam at night and said to him, “If the men have come to call for you, rise, go with them. But only the word that I speak to you, it you shall do.”
And Balaam rose in the morning and saddled his female donkey, and he went with the princes of Moab.

And the nose of God burned because he was going. And the angel of Yahweh stationed himself in the way for an adversary to him. And he was riding on his female donkey, and two of his young men were with him.

And the female donkey saw the angel of Yahweh being stationed in the way, and his sword being drawn in his hand. And the female donkey turned aside from the way and went into the field. And Balaam struck the female donkey to turn her aside to the way.
And the angel of Yahweh stood in the narrow path of the vineyards, a wall from this and a wall from that.
And the female donkey saw the angel of Yahweh, and she pressed herself against the wall. And she pressed the foot of Balaam against the wall, and he added to strike her.
And the angel of Yahweh added to pass over, and he stood in a narrow place where there was no way to turn aside right or left.
And the female donkey saw the angel of Yahweh and lay down under Balaam. And the nose of Balaam burned, and he struck the female donkey with the staff.
And Yahweh opened the mouth of the female donkey, and she said to Balaam, “What have I done to you, that you have struck me these three times?”
And Balaam said to the female donkey, “Because you have abused me! If only there were a sword in my hand, for I would kill you now!”

And the female donkey said to Balaam, “Am I not your female donkey on which you have ridden from since you were until this day? Being accustomed, have I been accustomed to do thus to you?” And he said, “No.”
And Yahweh uncovered the eyes of Balaam, and he saw the angel of Yahweh being stationed in the way and his sword being drawn in his hand. And he bowed and prostrated himself to his nostrils.
And the angel of Yahweh said to him, “Why have you struck your female donkey these three times? Behold, I, I have come out for an adversary, for the way is precipitous in front of me.
And the female donkey saw me and turned aside to my face these three times. Unless she turned aside from my face, then now I would have killed also you and kept her alive.”
And Balaam said to the angel of Yahweh, “I have sinned, for I did not know that you were being stationed to meet me in the way. And now, if it is evil in your eyes, let me return for myself.”
And the angel of Yahweh said to Balaam, “Go with the men, but only the word that I speak to you, it you shall speak.” And Balaam went with the princes of Balak.
And Balak heard that Balaam came, and he went out to meet him to the city of Moab, which is on the border of Arnon, which is at the end of the border.
And Balak said to Balaam, “Sending, did I not send to you to call for you? Why did you not come to me? Am I truly not able to honor you?”
And Balaam said to Balak, “Behold, I have come to you. Now, being able, am I able to speak anything? The word that God puts in my mouth, it I will speak.”
And Balaam went with Balak, and they came to Kiriath Huzoth.
And Balak sacrificed cattle and sheep and sent to Balaam and to the princes who were with him.
And it happened in the morning that Balak took Balaam and brought him up to Bamoth Baal, and he saw from there the end of the people.
And Balaam said to Balak, “Build for me in this place seven altars, and prepare for me in this place seven bulls and seven rams.”
And Balak did as Balaam had spoken, and Balak and Balaam made a bull and a ram go up on the altar.

And Balaam said to Balak, “Station yourself beside your burnt offering, and let me go. Perhaps Yahweh will encounter to meet me, and the word of what he makes me see, I will declare to you.” And he went to a bare height.
And God encountered Balaam, and he said to him, “I arranged the seven altars, and I made a bull and a ram go up on the altar.”
And Yahweh put a word in the mouth of Balaam, and he said, “Return to Balak, and thus you shall speak.”
And he returned to him, and behold, being stationed beside his burnt offering, he and all the princes of Moab.

And he lifted up his oracle and said,
“From Aram Balak has led me,
the king of Moab from the mountains of the east:
‘Come, curse Jacob for me,
and come, denounce Israel.’

What will I curse? God has not cursed.
And what will I denounce? Yahweh has not denounced.

For from a head of rocks I see him,
and from hills I look at him.
Behold, a people dwells alone,
and among the nations it does not reckon itself.

Who has counted the dust of Jacob,
or a number, the fourth of Israel?
May my soul die a death of upright ones,
and may my end be like his!”
And Balak said to Balaam, “What have you done to me? I brought you to curse my enemies, and behold, blessing, you have blessed!”
And he answered and said, “Is it not what Yahweh puts in my mouth, it I shall keep to speak?”
And Balak said to him, “Please come with me to another place from which you will see him. Only his end you will see, and all of him you will not see. And curse him for me from there.”
And he took him to the field of Zophim, to the head of the Pisgah. And he built seven altars and made a bull and a ram go up on the altar.
And he said to Balak, “Station yourself thus beside your burnt offering, and I will encounter thus.”
And Yahweh encountered Balaam and put a word in his mouth, and he said, “Return to Balak, and thus you shall speak.”
And he came to him, and behold him being stationed beside his burnt offering, and the princes of Moab with him. And Balak said to him, “What has Yahweh spoken?”

And he lifted up his oracle and said,
“Rise, Balak, and hear!
Give ear unto me, son of him, Zippor!

God is not a man that he lies,
or a son of a man that he changes his mind.
Has he said and will not do?
And has he spoken and will not raise up?

Behold, to bless I have taken,
and he has blessed, and I cannot return it.

He has not looked at iniquity in Jacob,
and he has not seen trouble in Israel.
Yahweh his God is with him,
and the shout of a king is in him.

God is bringing them out from Egypt;
as the horns of a wild ox for him.

For there is no omen against Jacob,
and no divination against Israel.
According to the time it will be said to Jacob and to Israel,
‘What has God done!’

Behold, a people rises up like a lioness,
and like a lion it lifts itself up.
It will not lie down until it eats prey
and drinks blood of slain ones.”
And Balak said to Balaam, “Both cursing, you shall not curse him, and blessing, you shall not bless him!”
And Balaam answered and said to Balak, “Did I not speak to you, saying, ‘All that Yahweh speaks, it I must do’?”
And Balak said to Balaam, “Come, please, let me take you to another place. Perhaps it will be right in the eyes of God, and you will curse him for me from there.”
And Balak took Balaam to the head of the Peor, the one looking down upon the face of the wasteland.
And Balaam said to Balak, “Build for me in this place seven altars, and prepare for me in this place seven bulls and seven rams.”
And Balak did as Balaam had said, and he made a bull and a ram go up on the altar.
And Balaam saw that it was good in the eyes of Yahweh to bless Israel, and he did not go as time by time to meet omens, and he set his face to the wilderness.
And Balaam lifted up his eyes and saw Israel dwelling according to its tribes, and the Spirit of God was upon him.

And he lifted up his oracle and said,
“The declaration of Balaam, the son of him, Beor,
and the declaration of the man, opened of the eye,

the declaration of the one hearing the words of God,
who sees the vision of the Almighty,
falling down and uncovered of eyes:

How good are your tents, Jacob,
your dwellings, Israel!

Like wadis they are stretched out,
like gardens upon a river,
like aloes Yahweh has planted,
like cedars upon water.

Water will flow from his buckets,
and his seed will be in many waters.
And his king will be higher than Agag,
and his kingdom will be lifted up.

God is bringing him out from Egypt;
as the horns of a wild ox for him.
He will devour nations, his adversaries,
and their bones he will crush,
and with his arrows he will shatter.

He bowed down, he lay down like a lion,
and like a lioness, who will raise him up?
Ones blessing you are blessed,
and ones cursing you are cursed.”
And the nose of Balak burned toward Balaam, and he clapped his palms. And Balak said to Balaam, “To curse my enemies I called you, and behold, blessing, you have blessed these three times.
And now, flee for yourself to your place. I said, ‘Honoring, I will honor you,’ and behold, Yahweh has withheld you from honor.”
And Balaam said to Balak, “Did I not also speak to your messengers whom you sent to me, saying,
‘If Balak gives to me the fullness of his house, silver and gold, I will not be able to pass over the mouth of Yahweh, to do good or evil from my own heart. What Yahweh speaks, it I will speak’?
And now, behold me, going to my people. Come, I will counsel you what this people will do to your people in the end of the days.”

And he lifted up his oracle and said,
“The declaration of Balaam, the son of him, Beor,
and the declaration of the man, opened of the eye,

the declaration of the one hearing the words of God,
and the one knowing the knowledge of the Most High;
he sees the vision of the Almighty,
falling down and uncovered of eyes:

I see him, but not now;
I look at him, but not near.
A star has trodden from Jacob,
and a scepter has risen from Israel.
And it has shattered the edges of Moab
and destroyed all the sons of Seth.

And Edom will be a possession,
and Seir, his enemies, will be a possession,
but Israel is doing strength.

And he will rule from Jacob,
and he will destroy a survivor from a city.”

And he saw Amalek, and he lifted up his oracle and said,
“First of nations is Amalek,
and its end is unto destruction.”

And he saw the Kenite, and he lifted up his oracle and said,
“Permanent is your dwelling,
and set in the rock is your nest.

Nevertheless, Kain will be to burn
until when Asshur takes you captive.”

And he lifted up his oracle and said,
“Woe! Who will live from God setting it?

And ships from the hand of Kittim,
and they will afflict Asshur, and they will afflict Eber,
and he also is unto destruction.”
And Balaam rose and went and returned to his place, and Balak also went to his way.
And Israel dwelled in the Shittim, and the people began to commit fornication with the daughters of Moab.
And they called to the people for the sacrifices of their gods, and the people ate and prostrated themselves to their gods.
And Israel was yoked to Baal of Peor, and the nose of Yahweh burned against Israel.
And Yahweh said to Moses, “Take all of the heads of the people and hang them to Yahweh in front of the sun, and let the burning of the nose of Yahweh return from Israel.”
And Moses said to the judges of Israel, “Kill, a man, his men, the ones being yoked to Baal of Peor.”

And behold, a man from the sons of Israel came and brought near to his brothers the Midianites, to the eyes of Moses and to the eyes of all of the congregation of the sons of Israel. And they were weeping at the opening of the tent of meeting.
And Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron, the priest, saw, and he rose from the midst of the congregation and took a spear in his hand.
And he went after the man of Israel to the tent, and he pierced the two of them, the man of Israel and the woman, to her stomach. And the plague was restrained from upon the sons of Israel.
And the ones dying by the plague were 24,000.
And Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

“Phinehas the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron, the priest, has returned my heat from upon the sons of Israel by him being jealous with my jealousy in their midst, and I did not finish the sons of Israel in my jealousy.
Therefore say, ‘Behold me, giving to him my covenant of peace.
And it shall be for him and for his seed after him a covenant of a priesthood of eternity, because he was jealous for his God, and he made atonement for the sons of Israel.’”
And the name of the man of Israel, the one being struck, who was struck with the Midianitess, was Zimri the son of Salu, a leader of a house of a father for the Simeonite.
And the name of the woman, the one being struck, the Midianitess, was Kozbi the daughter of Zur. He was a head of peoples, a house of a father in Midian.
And Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
“Oppose the Midianites, and strike them,

for they are opposing you by their deceptions with which they deceived you on the matter of Peor and on the matter of Kozbi, the daughter of the leader of Midian, their sister, the one being struck on the day of the plague on the matter of Peor.”
And it happened after the plague that Yahweh spoke to Moses and to Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest, saying,
“Lift up the head of all the congregation of the sons of Israel, from a son of 20 years and upward, according to the house of their fathers, everyone who goes out to war in Israel.”
And Moses spoke and Eleazar the priest to them in the plains of Moab beside the Jordan at Jericho, saying,
“From a son of 20 years and upward, just as Yahweh commanded Moses.” And the sons of Israel, the ones coming out from the land of Egypt:
Reuben was the firstborn of Israel. The sons of Reuben: Hanoch, the clan of the Hanochite; of Pallu, the clan of the Palluite;
of Hezron, the clan of the Hezronite; of Carmi, the clan of the Carmite.
These were the clans of the Reubenite. And their counted ones were 43,730.
And the sons of Pallu: Eliab.

And the sons of Eliab: Nemuel and Dathan and Abiram. It is Dathan and Abiram, the called ones of the congregation, who fought against Moses and against Aaron in the congregation of Korah when they fought against Yahweh.
And the earth opened its mouth and swallowed them and Korah when the congregation died, when the fire ate 250 men, and they were for a sign.
And the sons of Korah did not die.
The sons of Simeon according to their clans: of Nemuel, the clan of the Nemuelite; of Jamin, the clan of the Jaminite; of Jachin, the clan of the Jachinite;
of Zerah, the clan of the Zerahite; of Shaul, the clan of the Shaulite.
These were the clans of the Simeonite: 22,200.
The sons of Gad according to their clans: of Zephon, the clan of the Zephonite; of Haggi, the clan of the Haggite; of Shuni, the clan of the Shunite;
of Ozni, the clan of the Oznite; of Eri, the clan of the Erite;
of Arod, the clan of the Arodite; of Areli, the clan of the Arelite.
These were the clans of the sons of Gad according to their counted ones: 40,500.
The sons of Judah were Er and Onan, and Er died and Onan in the land of Canaan.
And the sons of Judah according to their clans were: of Shelah, the clan of the Shelanite; of Perez, the clan of the Perezite; of Zerah, the clan of the Zerahite.
And the sons of Perez were: of Hezron, the clan of the Hezronite; of Hamul, the clan of the Hamulite.
These were the clans of Judah according to their counted ones: 76,500.
The sons of Issachar according to their clans: Tola, the clan of the Tolaite; of Puvah, the clan of the Punite;
of Jashub, the clan of the Jashubite; of Shimron, the clan of the Shimronite.
These were the clans of Issachar according to their counted ones: 64,300.
The sons of Zebulun according to their clans: of Sered, the clan of the Seredite; of Elon, the clan of the Elonite; of Jahleel, the clan of the Jahleelite.
These were the clans of the Zebulunite according to their counted ones: 60,500.
The sons of Joseph according to their clans: Manasseh and Ephraim.
The sons of Manasseh: of Makir, the clan of the Makirite; and Makir fathered Gilead; of Gilead, the clan of the Gileadite.
These were the sons of Gilead: Iezer, the clan of the Iezerite; of Helek, the clan of the Helekite;
and Asriel, the clan of the Asrielite; and Shechem, the clan of the Shechemite;
and Shemida, the clan of the Shemidaite; and Hepher, the clan of the Hepherite.
And Zelophehad the son of Hepher, there were not sons for him, but daughters. And the name of the daughters of Zelophehad were Mahlah, and Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.
These were the clans of Manasseh. And their counted ones: 52,700.
These were the sons of Ephraim according to their clans: of Shuthelah, the clan of the Shuthelahite; of Becher, the clan of the Becherite; of Tahan, the clan of the Tahanite.
And these were the sons of Shuthelah: of Eran, the clan of the Eranite.
These were the clans of the sons of Ephraim according to their counted ones: 32,500. These were the sons of Joseph according to their clans.
The sons of Benjamin according to their clans: of Bela, the clan of the Belaite; of Ashbel, the clan of the Ashbelite; of Ahiram, the clan of the Ahiramite;
of Shephupham, the clan of the Shuphamite; of Hupham, the clan of the Huphamite.
And the sons of Bela were Ard and Naaman: the clan of the Ardite; of Naaman, the clan of the Naamite.
These were the sons of Benjamin according to their clans. And their counted ones: 45,600.
These were the sons of Dan according to their clans: of Shuham, the clan of the Shuhamite. These were the clans of Dan according to their clans.
All the clans of the Shuhamite according to their counted ones: 64,400.
The sons of Asher according to their clans: of Imnah, the clan of the Imnite; of Ishvi, the clan of the Ishvite; of Beriah, the clan of the Beriite.
Of the sons of Beriah: of Heber, the clan of the Heberite; of Malchiel, the clan of the Malchielite.
And the name of the daughter of Asher was Serah.
These were the clans of the sons of Asher according to their counted ones: 53,400.
The sons of Naphtali according to their clans: of Jahzeel, the clan of the Jahzeelite; of Guni, the clan of the Gunite;
of Jezer, the clan of the Jezerite; of Shillem, the clan of the Shillemite.
These were the clans of Naphtali according to their clans. And their counted ones: 45,400.
These were the counted ones of the sons of Israel: 601,730.
And Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
“To these the land shall be divided in an inheritance by the number of the names.
For the many you shall increase its inheritance, and for the few you shall decrease its inheritance. A man to the mouth of its counted ones, its inheritance shall be given.
Only by lots shall the land be divided. According to the names of the tribes of their fathers they shall inherit.
Upon the mouth of the lot shall its inheritance be divided, between the many to the few.”
And these were the counted ones of the Levite according to their clans: of Gershon, the clan of the Gershonite; of Kohath, the clan of the Kohathite; of Merari, the clan of the Merarite.
These were the clans of Levi: the clan of the Libnite, the clan of the Hebronite, the clan of the Mahlite, the clan of the Mushite, the clan of the Korahite. And Kohath fathered Amram.
And the name of the wife of Amram was Jochebed, a daughter of Levi, whom she bore to Levi in Egypt. And she bore to Amram Aaron and Moses and Miriam their sister.
And were born to Aaron Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.
And Nadab died and Abihu when they presented strange fire to the face of Yahweh.

And their counted ones were 23,000, every male from a son of a month and upward. For they were not counted in the midst of the sons of Israel, because an inheritance in the midst of the sons of Israel was not given to them.
These were the counted ones of Moses and Eleazar the priest, who counted the sons of Israel in the plains of Moab beside the Jordan at Jericho.
And among these there was not a man from the counted ones of Moses and Aaron the priest, who counted the sons of Israel in the wilderness of Sinai.
For Yahweh had said to them, “Dying, they shall die in the wilderness.” And a man was not left from them, except Caleb the son of Jephunneh and Joshua the son of Nun.

And the daughters of Zelophehad the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the clans of Manasseh the son of Joseph, came near. And these were the names of his daughters: Mahlah, Noah and Hoglah and Milcah and Tirzah.
And they stood to the face of Moses and to the face of Eleazar the priest and to the face of the leaders and all the congregation at the opening of the tent of meeting, saying,

“Our father died in the wilderness, and he was not in the midst of the congregation, the ones congregating against Yahweh, in the congregation of Korah. For in his sin he died, and sons were not for him.
Why should the name of our father be taken away from the midst of his clan because there is not for him a son? Give to us a possession in the midst of the brothers of our father.”
And Moses presented their judgment to the face of Yahweh.
And Yahweh said to Moses, saying,

“The daughters of Zelophehad are speaking rightly. Giving, you shall give to them a possession of an inheritance in the midst of the brothers of their father, and you shall pass the inheritance of their father to them.
And you shall speak to the sons of Israel, saying, ‘A man, when he dies and there is not a son for him, then you shall pass his inheritance to his daughter.
And if there is not a daughter for him, then you shall give his inheritance to his brothers.
And if there are not brothers for him, then you shall give his inheritance to the brothers of his father.

And if there are not brothers for his father, then you shall give his inheritance to his flesh, the nearest to him from his clan, and he shall possess it. And it shall be for the sons of Israel for a statute of judgment, just as Yahweh has commanded Moses.’”
And Yahweh said to Moses, “Go up to this mountain of the Abarim, and see the land that I have given to the sons of Israel.
And you shall see it and be gathered to your peoples, also you, just as Aaron your brother was gathered,

just as you rebelled against my mouth in the wilderness of Zin, in the strife of the congregation, to consecrate me in the waters to their eyes.” They are the waters of Meribah Kadesh, the wilderness of Zin.
And Moses spoke to Yahweh, saying,
“May Yahweh, the God of the spirits of all flesh, count a man over the congregation

who will go out to their face and who will come in to their face, and who will bring them out and who will bring them in, and the congregation of Yahweh will not be like sheep that there is not a shepherd for them.”
And Yahweh said to Moses, “Take for yourself Joshua the son of Nun, a man in whom is a spirit, and you shall lay your hand on him.
And you shall stand him to the face of Eleazar the priest and to the face of all the congregation, and you shall command him to their eyes.
And you shall give from your splendor on him, so that all the congregation of the sons of Israel will hear.

And to the face of Eleazar the priest he shall stand, and he shall ask for him in the judgment of the Urim to the face of Yahweh. Upon his mouth they shall go out and upon his mouth they shall come in, he and all the sons of Israel with him and all the congregation.”
And Moses did just as Yahweh had commanded him, and he took Joshua and stood him to the face of Eleazar the priest and to the face of all the congregation,
and he laid his hands on him, and he commanded him, just as Yahweh spoke in the hand of Moses.
And Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
“Command the sons of Israel and say to them, ‘My offering, my bread for my gifts, a scent of my pleasing, you shall keep to present to me in its appointed time.’
And you shall say to them, ‘This is the gift that you shall present to Yahweh: perfect male lambs, sons of a year, two for the day, a continual burnt offering.
The one male lamb you shall do in the morning, and the second male lamb you shall do between the evenings,
and the tenth of the ephah of flour for a grain offering, mixed with beaten oil, the fourth of the hin,
a burnt offering of continuity, the one done at Mount Sinai, for a scent of pleasing, a gift to Yahweh.
And its drink offering shall be the fourth of the hin for the one male lamb. In the holy place pour out a drink offering of intoxicating drink to Yahweh.
And the second male lamb you shall do between the evenings. Like the grain offering of the morning and like its drink offering you shall do, a gift, a scent of pleasing to Yahweh.
And on the day of the Sabbath: two male lambs, sons of a year, perfect, and two tenths of flour, a grain offering mixed with the oil, and its drink offering;
a burnt offering of a Sabbath on its Sabbath, upon the burnt offering of the continuity and its drink offering.
And at the heads of your months, you shall present a burnt offering to Yahweh: two bulls, sons of cattle, and one ram; seven male lambs, sons of a year, perfect;
and three tenths of flour, a grain offering mixed with the oil for the one bull; and two tenths of flour, a grain offering mixed with the oil for the one ram;
and a tenth, a tenth of flour, a grain offering mixed with the oil for the one male lamb; a burnt offering, a scent of pleasing, a gift to Yahweh.

And their drink offerings shall be the half of the hin for the bull, and the third of the hin for the ram, and the fourth of the hin for the male lamb, wine. This is a burnt offering of a month on its month, for the months of the year,
and one buck of goats for a sin offering to Yahweh, upon the burnt offering of the continuity it shall be done, and its drink offering.
And on the first month, on day 14 of the month, is the Passover of Yahweh.
And on day 15 of this month is a festival. Seven days unleavened bread shall be eaten.
On the first day is an assembly of holiness; you shall not do any work of service.
And you shall present a gift, a burnt offering to Yahweh: two bulls, sons of cattle, and one ram, and seven male lambs, sons of a year. They shall be perfect for you.
And their grain offering: flour mixed with the oil, three tenths for the bull and two tenths for the ram, you shall do.
A tenth, a tenth you shall do for the one male lamb, for the seven male lambs,
and one buck, a sin offering, to make atonement for you.
Besides the burnt offering of the morning, which is for the burnt offering of the continuity, you shall do these.
Like these you shall do for the day, seven days, bread of gift, a scent of pleasing to Yahweh; upon the burnt offering of the continuity it shall be done, and its drink offering.
And on the seventh day shall be for you an assembly of holiness; you shall not do any work of service.
And on the day of the firstfruits, when you present a new grain offering to Yahweh in your weeks, an assembly of holiness shall be for you; you shall not do any work of service.
And you shall present a burnt offering for a scent of pleasing to Yahweh: two bulls, sons of cattle; one ram; seven male lambs, sons of a year;
and their grain offering, flour mixed with the oil, three tenths for the one bull, two tenths for the one ram,
a tenth, a tenth for the one male lamb, for the seven male lambs;
one buck of goats, to make atonement for you.
Besides the burnt offering of the continuity and its grain offering you shall do; they shall be perfect for you, and their drink offerings.
And in the seventh month, on one of the month, shall be an assembly of holiness for you. You shall not do any work of service. It shall be for you a day of a loud blast.
And you shall do a burnt offering for a scent of pleasing to Yahweh: one bull, a son of cattle; one ram; seven male lambs, sons of a year, perfect;
and their grain offering, flour mixed with the oil, three tenths for the bull, two tenths for the ram,
and one tenth for the one male lamb, for the seven male lambs;
and one buck of goats, a sin offering, to make atonement for you;

besides the burnt offering of the month and its grain offering, and the burnt offering of the continuity and its grain offering, and their drink offerings, according to their ordinance, for a scent of pleasing, a gift to Yahweh.
And on ten of this seventh month shall be an assembly of holiness for you, and you shall humble your souls. You shall not do any work.
And you shall present a burnt offering to Yahweh, a scent of pleasing: one bull, a son of cattle; one ram; seven male lambs, sons of a year. They shall be perfect for you.
And their grain offering, flour mixed with the oil: three tenths for the bull, two tenths for the one ram,
a tenth, a tenth for the one male lamb, for the seven male lambs;
one buck of goats, a sin offering, besides the sin offering of the atonement and the burnt offering of the continuity and its grain offering, and their drink offerings.
And on day 15 of the seventh month shall be an assembly of holiness for you. You shall not do any work of service, and you shall celebrate a festival to Yahweh seven days.
And you shall present a burnt offering, a gift, a scent of pleasing to Yahweh: 13 bulls, sons of cattle; two rams; 14 male lambs, sons of a year. They shall be perfect.
And their grain offering, flour mixed with the oil: three tenths for the one bull, for 13 bulls; two tenths for the one ram, for two rams;
and a tenth, a tenth for the one male lamb, for 14 male lambs;
and one buck of goats, a sin offering; besides the burnt offering of the continuity, its grain offering, and its drink offering.
And on the second day: 12 bulls, sons of cattle; two rams; 14 male lambs, sons of a year, perfect;
and their grain offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the male lambs by their number according to the ordinance;
and one buck of goats, a sin offering; besides the burnt offering of the continuity and its grain offering and their drink offerings.
And on the third day: 11 bulls; two rams; 14 male lambs, sons of a year, perfect;
and their grain offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the male lambs by their number according to the ordinance;
and one buck of a sin offering; besides the burnt offering of the continuity and its grain offering and its drink offering.
And on the fourth day: ten bulls; two rams; 14 male lambs, sons of a year, perfect;
their grain offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the male lambs by their number according to the ordinance;
and one buck of goats, a sin offering; besides the burnt offering of the continuity, its grain offering, and its drink offering.
And on the fifth day: nine bulls; two rams; 14 male lambs, sons of a year, perfect;
and their grain offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the male lambs by their number according to the ordinance;
and one buck of a sin offering; besides the burnt offering of the continuity and its grain offering and its drink offering.
And on the sixth day: eight bulls; two rams; 14 male lambs, sons of a year, perfect;
and their grain offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the male lambs by their number according to the ordinance;
and one buck of a sin offering; besides the burnt offering of the continuity, its grain offering, and its drink offering.
And on the seventh day: seven bulls; two rams; 14 male lambs, sons of a year, perfect;
and their grain offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the male lambs by their number according to their ordinance;
and one buck of a sin offering; besides the burnt offering of the continuity, its grain offering, and its drink offering.
On the eighth day shall be a holiday for you. You shall not do any work of service.
And you shall present a burnt offering, a gift, a scent of pleasing to Yahweh: one bull; one ram; seven male lambs, sons of a year, perfect;
their grain offering and their drink offerings for the bull, for the ram, and for the male lambs by their number according to the ordinance;
and one buck of a sin offering, besides the burnt offering of the continuity and its grain offering and its drink offering.

These you shall do for Yahweh at your appointed times, besides your vows and your freewill offerings, for your burnt offerings, and for your grain offerings, and for your drink offerings, and for your peace offerings.’”
And Moses said to the sons of Israel according to all that Yahweh had commanded Moses.
And Moses spoke to the heads of the tribes of the sons of Israel, saying, “This is the word that Yahweh has commanded:
A man, when he vows a vow to Yahweh or swears an oath to bind a bond on his life, he shall not profane his word. According to everything going out from his mouth he shall do.
And a woman, when she vows a vow to Yahweh and binds a bond in the house of her father in her youth,
and her father hears her vow and her bond that she bound on her life, and her father keeps silent to her, then all her vows shall stand, and every bond that she bound on her life shall stand.
And if her father forbids her on the day of his hearing, all her vows and her bonds that she bound on her life shall not stand, and Yahweh will forgive her, for her father forbade her.
And if being, she is for a man, and her vows are upon her, or the thoughtless speech of her lips that she bound on her life,
and her husband hears on the day of his hearing, and he keeps silent to her, then her vows shall stand, and her bonds that she bound on her life shall stand.
And if, on the day of her husband’s hearing, he forbids her, then he breaks her vow that is upon her and the thoughtless speech of her lips that she bound on her life, and Yahweh will forgive her.
And the vow of a widow and one driven out, everything that she bound on her life, shall stand upon her.
And if in the house of her husband she vowed, or bound a bond on her life with an oath,
and her husband hears, and he keeps silent to her—he does not forbid her—then all her vows shall stand, and every bond that she bound on her life shall stand.

And if breaking, her husband breaks them on the day of his hearing, all that goes out of her lips for her vows and for the bond of her life shall not stand. Her husband has broken them, and Yahweh will forgive her.
Every vow and every oath of a bond to humble a soul, her husband may make it stand, and her husband may break it.

And if keeping silent, her husband keeps silent to her from day to day, then he makes stand all her vows or all her bonds that are on her. He has made them stand because he kept silent to her on the day of his hearing.
And if breaking, he breaks them after his hearing, then he shall lift up her iniquity.”
These are the statutes that Yahweh commanded Moses, between a man to his wife, between a father to his daughter in her youth in the house of her father.
And Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
“Avenge the vengeance of the sons of Israel from with the Midianites. Afterward you shall be gathered to your peoples.”
And Moses spoke to the people, saying, “Equip from with you men for the army. And they shall be against Midian to give the vengeance of Yahweh on Midian.
A thousand for the tribe, a thousand for the tribe for all the tribes of Israel you shall send for the army.”
And were selected from the thousands of Israel a thousand for the tribe, 12,000 equipped ones of an army.

And Moses sent them, a thousand for the tribe for the army, them and Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest for the army, and the vessels of the holy place and the trumpets of the alarm were in his hand.
And they fought against Midian, just as Yahweh had commanded Moses, and they killed every male.
And they killed the kings of Midian upon their slain ones: Evi and Rekem and Zur and Hur and Reba, the five kings of Midian; and Balaam the son of Beor they killed by the sword.
And the sons of Israel took captive the women of Midian and their children, and they plundered all their animal and all their livestock and all their strength.
And all their cities with their dwellings and all their encampments they burned with the fire.
And they took all the plunder and all the spoil, among the man and among the animal,

and they brought to Moses and to Eleazar the priest and to the congregation of the sons of Israel the captive and the spoil and the plunder to the camp, to the plains of Moab, which are beside the Jordan at Jericho.
And Moses and Eleazar the priest and all the leaders of the congregation went out to meet them to the outside of the camp.
And Moses was angry against the counted ones of the strength, the princes of the thousands and the princes of the hundreds, the ones coming from the army of the battle.
And Moses said to them, “Have you kept every female alive?
Behold, they were to the sons of Israel by the word of Balaam to select unfaithfulness against Yahweh on the matter of Peor, and the plague was among the congregation of Yahweh.
And now, kill every male among the children, and kill every woman having known a man to the bed of a male.
And keep alive for you all children among the women who have not known a bed of a male.

And you, camp to the outside of the camp seven days. All ones killing a person and all ones touching a slain one, you shall purify yourselves on the third day and on the seventh day, you and your captive.
And every cloth and every vessel of skin and every work of goats and every vessel of wood you shall purify.”
And Eleazar the priest said to the men of the army, the ones having gone to the battle, “This is the statute of the law that Yahweh commanded Moses:
Only the gold and the silver, the bronze, the iron, the tin, and the lead,
every thing that goes in the fire, you shall pass in the fire, and it will be clean; only in water of impurity it shall be purified. And all that does not go in the fire, you shall pass in the water.
And you shall wash your clothes on the seventh day, and you will be clean, and after you may go to the camp.”
And Yahweh said to Moses, saying,
“Lift up the head of the spoil of the captive, among the man and among the animal, you and Eleazar the priest and the heads of the fathers of the congregation.
And you shall divide the spoil between the seizers of the battle, the ones having gone out for the army, and between all the congregation.

And you shall raise a levy for Yahweh from with the men of the battle, the ones having gone out for the army, one life from the 500, from the man and from the cattle and from the donkeys and from the flock.
You shall take from their half and give the contribution of Yahweh to Eleazar the priest.

And from the half of the sons of Israel you shall take one seized one from the 50, from the man, from the cattle, from the donkeys, and from the flock, from all the animal, and you shall give them to the Levites, the ones keeping the keeping of the Dwelling of Yahweh.”
And Moses and Eleazar the priest did just as Yahweh commanded Moses.
And the spoil, the rest of the plunder that the people of the army plundered: 675,000 flock,
and 72,000 cattle,
and 61,000 donkeys,
and a life of a man, from the women who had not known a bed of a male, every life, 32,000.
And the half was the portion of the ones having gone out in the army. The number of the flock: 337,500.
And the levy for Yahweh from the flock: 675.
And the cattle: 36,000. And their levy for Yahweh: 72.
And the donkeys: 30,500. And their levy for Yahweh: 61.
And a life of a man: 16,000. And their levy for Yahweh: 32 lives.
And Moses gave the levy of the contribution of Yahweh to Eleazar the priest, just as Yahweh commanded Moses.
And from the half of the sons of Israel, which Moses divided from the men having fought—
and the half of the congregation from the flock was 337,500,
and 36,000 cattle,
and 30,500 donkeys,
and 16,000 lives of a man—

and Moses took from the half of the sons of Israel the seized one, one from the 50, from the man and from the animal, and he gave them to the Levites, the ones keeping the keeping of the Dwelling of Yahweh, just as Yahweh commanded Moses.
And the counted ones who were for the thousands of the army, the princes of the thousands and the princes of the hundreds, came near to Moses.
And they said to Moses, “Your servants have lifted up the head of the men of the battle who were in our hand, and a man from us is not missing.
And we have presented the offering of Yahweh, a man what he found, a vessel of gold—armlet, and bracelet, signet ring, earring, and ornament—to make atonement for our lives to the face of Yahweh.”
And Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold from with them, every vessel of work.
And all the gold of the contribution that they raised to Yahweh was 16,750 shekels, from with the princes of the thousands and from with the princes of the hundreds.
The men of the army had plundered, a man for himself.

And Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold from with the princes of the thousands and the hundreds, and they brought it to the tent of meeting, a memorial for the sons of Israel to the face of Yahweh.
And the livestock for the sons of Reuben and for the sons of Gad was many, very mighty. And they saw the land of Jazer and the land of Gilead, and behold, the place was a place of livestock.
And the sons of Gad and the sons of Reuben came and said to Moses and to Eleazar the priest and to the leaders of the congregation, saying,
“Ataroth, and Dibon, and Jazer, and Nimrah, and Heshbon, and Elealeh, and Sebam, and Nebo, and Beon,
the land that Yahweh struck to the face of the congregation of Israel, it is a land of livestock, and to your servants is livestock.”
And they said, “If we have found favor in your eyes, let this land be given to your servants for a possession. May you not pass us over the Jordan.”
And Moses said to the sons of Gad and to the sons of Reuben, “Will your brothers go to the battle, and you, you will dwell here?
And why do you forbid the heart of the sons of Israel from passing over to the land that Yahweh has given to them?
Thus your fathers did when I sent them from Kadesh Barnea to see the land.
And they went up as far as Wadi Eshkol, and they saw the land, and they forbade the heart of the sons of Israel not to go to the land that Yahweh had given to them.
And the nose of Yahweh burned on that day, and he swore, saying,
‘If the men, the ones going up from Egypt, from a son of 20 years and upward, see the ground that I swore to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob! For they did not fill after me,
except Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite and Joshua the son of Nun, because they filled after Yahweh.’
And the nose of Yahweh burned against Israel, and he made them wander in the wilderness 40 years, until the finishing of all the generation, the ones doing the evil in the eyes of Yahweh.
And behold, you have risen instead of your fathers, a brood of sinful men, to sweep away more upon the burning of the nose of Yahweh to Israel.
For you will return from after him, and he will add still to make him rest in the wilderness, and you will destroy all this people.”
And they came near to him and said, “We will build pens of a flock for our livestock here, and cities for our children.

And we, we will be equipped, being hurried, to the face of the sons of Israel, until whenever we have brought them to their place. And our children will dwell in the cities of the fortification from the face of the dwellers of the land.
We will not return to our houses until the sons of Israel have inherited, a man his inheritance.
For we will not inherit with them from across to the Jordan and beyond, for our inheritance has come to us from across the Jordan toward the sunrise.”
And Moses said to them, “If you do this word, if you are equipped to the face of Yahweh for the battle,
and every equipped one passes over the Jordan for you to the face of Yahweh until he has dispossessed his enemies from his face,
and the land is subdued to the face of Yahweh, then after you shall return, and you will be innocent from Yahweh and from Israel, and this land will be for you for a possession to the face of Yahweh.
But if you do not do so, behold, you have sinned against Yahweh, and know your sin, that it will find you.
Build for you cities for your children and pens for your flock, and the thing going out from your mouth you shall do.”
And the sons of Gad and the sons of Reuben said to Moses, saying, “Your servants will do just as my master is commanding.
Our children, our wives, our livestock, and all our animal will be there in the cities of the Gilead.
And your servants will pass over, every equipped one of an army, to the face of Yahweh for the battle, just as my lord is speaking.”
And Moses commanded for them Eleazar the priest and Joshua the son of Nun and the heads of the fathers of the tribes for the sons of Israel.

And Moses said to them, “If the sons of Gad and the sons of Reuben pass over the Jordan with you, every equipped one for the war to the face of Yahweh, and the land is subdued to your faces, then you shall give to them the land of the Gilead for a possession.
But if they do not pass over, being equipped, with you, then they shall possess in your midst in the land of Canaan.”
And the sons of Gad and the sons of Reuben answered, saying, “What Yahweh has spoken to your servants, thus we will do.
We, we will pass over, being equipped, to the face of Yahweh to the land of Canaan, and with us will be the possession of our inheritance from across to the Jordan.”

And Moses gave to them, to the sons of Gad and to the sons of Reuben and to the half of the tribe of Manasseh the son of Joseph, the kingdom of Sihon the king of the Amorite and the kingdom of Og the king of the Bashan, the land to its cities in the borders, the cities of the land all around.
And the sons of Gad built Dibon and Ataroth and Aroer,
and Atroth Shophan and Jazer and Jogbehah,
and Beth Nimrah and Beth Haran, cities of fortification and pens of a flock.
And the sons of Reuben built Heshbon and Elealeh and Kiriathaim
and Nebo and Baal Meon (being changed of name) and Sibmah. And they called by names the names of the cities that they built.
And the sons of Machir the son of Manasseh went to Gilead and captured it, and he dispossessed the Amorite that was in it.
And Moses gave the Gilead to Machir the son of Manasseh, and he dwelled in it.
And Jair the son of Manasseh went and captured their villages, and he called them Havvoth Jair.
And Nobah went and captured Kenath and its daughters, and he called it Nobah, by his name.
These are the departures of the sons of Israel, who went out from the land of Egypt according to their armies in the hand of Moses and Aaron.
And Moses wrote their goings out according to their departures upon the mouth of Yahweh. And these were their departures according to their goings out.
And they set out from Rameses in the first month, on day 15 of the first month. From the next day of the Passover, the sons of Israel went out with a hand being high to the eyes of all the Egyptians,
and the Egyptians were burying those against whom Yahweh had struck, every firstborn, and against their gods Yahweh did judgments.
And the sons of Israel set out from Rameses and camped at Succoth.
And they set out from Succoth and camped at Etham, which is at the end of the wilderness.
And they set out from Etham and returned upon Pi Hahiroth, which is upon the face of Baal Zephon, and camped to the face of Migdol.
And they set out from the face of Hahiroth and passed over in the midst of the sea to the wilderness, and they went a way of three days in the wilderness of Etham and camped at Marah.
And they set out from Marah and came to Elim. And at Elim were 12 springs of water and 70 palm trees, and they camped there.
And they set out from Elim and camped upon the Sea of Reeds.
And they set out from the Sea of Reeds and camped in the wilderness of Sin.
And they set out from the wilderness of Sin and camped at Dophkah.
And they set out from Dophkah and camped at Alush.
And they set out from Alush and camped at Rephidim, and there was not water there for the people to drink.
And they set out from Rephidim and camped in the wilderness of Sinai.
And they set out from the wilderness of Sinai and camped at Kibroth Hattaavah.
And they set out from Kibroth Hattaavah and camped at Hazeroth.
And they set out from Hazeroth and camped at Rithmah.
And they set out from Rithmah and camped at Rimmon Perez.
And they set out from Rimmon Perez and camped at Libnah.
And they set out from Libnah and camped at Rissah.
And they set out from Rissah and camped at Kehelathah.
And they set out from Kehelathah and camped at Mount Shepher.
And they set out from Mount Shepher and camped at Haradah.
And they set out from Haradah and camped at Makheloth.
And they set out from Makheloth and camped at Tahath.
And they set out from Tahath and camped at Terah.
And they set out from Terah and camped at Mithkah.
And they set out from Mithkah and camped at Hashmonah.
And they set out from Hashmonah and camped at Moseroth.
And they set out from Moseroth and camped at Bene Jaakan.
And they set out from Bene Jaakan and camped at Hor Haggidgad.
And they set out from Hor Haggidgad and camped at Jotbathah.
And they set out from Jotbathah and camped at Abronah.
And they set out from Abronah and camped at Ezion Geber.
And they set out from Ezion Geber and camped in the wilderness of Zin (it is Kadesh).
And they set out from Kadesh and camped at Mount Hor, at the end of the land of Edom.

And Aaron the priest went up to Mount Hor upon the mouth of Yahweh, and he died there in year 40 of the going out of the sons of Israel from the land of Egypt, in the fifth month, on one of the month.
And Aaron was a son of 123 years when he died on Mount Hor.
And the Canaanite, the king of Arad (and he was dwelling in the Negev in the land of Canaan), heard of the coming of the sons of Israel.
And they set out from Mount Hor and camped at Zalmonah.
And they set out from Zalmonah and camped at Punon.
And they set out from Punon and camped at Oboth.
And they set out from Oboth and camped at Iye Abarim, on the border of Moab.
And they set out from Iyim and camped at Dibon Gad.
And they set out from Dibon Gad and camped at Almon Diblathaim.
And they set out from Almon Diblathaim and camped in the mountains of the Abarim, to the face of Nebo.
And they set out from the mountains of the Abarim and camped in the plains of Moab beside the Jordan at Jericho.
And they camped beside the Jordan, from Beth Jeshimoth as far as Abel Shittim, in the plains of Moab.
And Yahweh spoke to Moses in the plains of Moab beside the Jordan at Jericho, saying,
“Speak to the sons of Israel and say to them, ‘When you are passing over the Jordan to the land of Canaan,

then you shall dispossess all the dwellers of the land from your face, and you shall destroy all their carved figures, and all the images of their molten metal you shall destroy, and all their high places you shall destroy.
And you shall possess the land and dwell in it, because to you I have given the land to possess it.

And you shall inherit the land by lot, according to your clans. For the many you shall increase its inheritance, and for the few you shall decrease its inheritance. To where it goes out for it, there the lot shall be for it. According to the tribes of your fathers you shall inherit.

And if you do not dispossess the dwellers of the land from your face, then whom you leave from them shall be for splinters in your eyes and for thorns in your sides, and they shall oppose you upon the land in which you are dwelling.
And it shall be that, just as I intended to do to them, I will do to you.’”
And Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
“Command the sons of Israel and say to them, ‘When you are going to the land of Canaan, this is the land that will fall to you in an inheritance, the land of Canaan according to its borders.
And the edge of the south shall be for you from the wilderness of Zin upon the hands of Edom. And the border of the south shall be for you from the end of the Sea of Salt to the east.

And the border shall turn for you from the south to the Ascent of Akrabbim and pass over to Zin, and its goings out shall be from the south to Kadesh Barnea, and it shall go out to Hazar Addar and pass over to Azmon.
And the border shall turn from Azmon to Wadi Egypt, and its goings out shall be to the sea.
And the border of the west, and it shall be for you the Great Sea and a border. This shall be for you the border of the west.
And this shall be for you the border of the north: from the Great Sea you shall mark a line for you to Mount Hor.
From Mount Hor you shall mark a line to Lebo Hamath, and the goings out of the border shall be to Zedad.
And the border shall go out to Ziphron, and its goings out shall be Hazar Enan. This shall be for you the border of the north.
And you shall mark a line for you for the border to the east, from Hazar Enan to Shepham.
And the border shall go down from Shepham to the Riblah, from east of Ain. And the border shall go down and strike upon the shoulder of the Sea of Chinnereth to the east.
And the border shall go down to the Jordan, and its goings out shall be the Sea of Salt. This shall be for you the land according to its borders all around.’”
And Moses commanded the sons of Israel, saying, “This is the land that you shall inherit by lot, which Yahweh has commanded to give to the nine tribes and the half of the tribe.
