For they have taken, the tribe of the sons of the Reubenite according to the house of their fathers and the tribe of the sons of the Gadite according to the house of their fathers, and the half of the tribe of Manasseh have taken their inheritance.
The two tribes and the half of the tribe have taken their inheritance from across to the Jordan at Jericho to the east, toward the sunrise.”
And Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
“These are the names of the men who will inherit the land for you: Eleazar the priest and Joshua the son of Nun.
And one leader, one leader from a tribe you shall take to inherit the land.

And these are the names of the men:
for the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh;
and for the tribe of the sons of Simeon, Shemuel the son of Ammihud;
for the tribe of Benjamin, Elidad the son of Chislon;
and for the tribe of the sons of Dan, a leader, Bukki the son of Jogli;
for the sons of Joseph, for the tribe of the sons of Manasseh, a leader, Hanniel the son of Ephod;
and for the tribe of the sons of Ephraim, a leader, Kemuel the son of Shiphtan;
and for the tribe of the sons of Zebulun, a leader, Elizaphan the son of Parnach;
and for the tribe of the sons of Issachar, a leader, Paltiel the son of Azzan;
and for the tribe of the sons of Asher, a leader, Ahihud the son of Shelomi;
and for the tribe of the sons of Naphtali, a leader, Pedahel the son of Ammihud.”
These are whom Yahweh commanded to make the sons of Israel inherit in the land of Canaan.
And Yahweh spoke to Moses in the plains of Moab beside the Jordan at Jericho, saying,
“Command the sons of Israel, and they shall give to the Levites from the inheritance of their possession cities to dwell. And pastureland for the cities around them you shall give to the Levites.
And the cities shall be for them to dwell, and their pasturelands shall be for their animal and for their property and for all their living thing.
And the pasturelands of the cities that you shall give to the Levites shall be from the wall of the city and outside 1,000 cubits all around.

And you shall measure from outside to the city the edge to the east 2,000 by the cubit, and the edge of the south 2,000 by the cubit, and the edge of the west 2,000 by the cubit, and the edge of the north 2,000 by the cubit, and the city in the midst. This shall be for them the pasturelands of the cities.
And the cities that you shall give to the Levites shall be the six cities of refuge, which you shall give for the fleeing there of the one having killed; and besides them you shall give 42 cities.
All of the cities that you shall give to the Levites shall be 48 cities, them and their pasturelands.

And the cities that you shall give from the possession of the sons of Israel: from with the many you shall increase, and from with the few you shall decrease. A man according to the mouth of his inheritance that they inherit shall give from his cities to the Levites.”
And Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
“Speak to the sons of Israel and say to them, ‘When you are passing over the Jordan to the land of Canaan,
then you shall make happen for you cities; cities of refuge they shall be for you. And shall flee there one having killed, one having struck a person by mistake.
And they will be for you the cities for refuge from one redeeming, and the one having killed will not die until his standing to the face of the congregation for the judgment.
And the cities that you shall give, six cities of refuge shall be for you.
The three cities you shall give from across to the Jordan, and the three cities you shall give in the land of Canaan; cities of refuge they shall be.
For the sons of Israel and for the sojourner and for the temporary resident in their midst these six cities shall be for refuge, for the fleeing there of everyone having struck a person by mistake.
But if he struck him with a vessel of iron and he died, he is one having killed. Dying, the one having killed shall be put to death.
And if with a stone of a hand, by which he dies, he struck him and he died, he is one having killed. Dying, the one having killed shall be put to death.
Or with a vessel of wood of a hand, by which he dies, he struck him and he died, he is one having killed. Dying, the one having killed shall be put to death.
The one redeeming the blood, he, he shall kill the one having killed. In his meeting with him, he, he shall kill him.
And if in hatred he pushed him, or he threw upon him on purpose, and he died,

or in hostility he struck him with his hand, and he died, dying, the one having struck shall be put to death; he is one having killed. The one redeeming the blood shall kill the one having killed in his meeting with him.
But if in suddenness, not in hostility, he pushed him, or he threw upon him any vessel not on purpose,
or with any stone, by which he dies, while not seeing, and he made fall upon him, and he died, and he was not an enemy to him and was not seeking his evil,
then the congregation shall judge between the one having struck and between the one redeeming the blood according to these ordinances.

And the congregation shall deliver the one having killed from the hand of the one redeeming the blood, and the congregation shall return him to the city of his refuge where he fled. And he shall dwell in it until the death of the great priest whom he anointed with the oil of the holy place.
But if going out, the one having killed goes out beyond the border of the city of his refuge where he flees,
and the one redeeming the blood finds him from outside to the border of the city of his refuge, and the one redeeming the blood kills the one having killed, there is not to him blood.
For in the city of his refuge he shall dwell until the death of the great priest. And after the death of the great priest, the one having killed shall return to the land of his possession.
And these shall be for you for a statute of judgment for your generations in all of your dwellings.
Everyone having struck a person, to the mouth of witnesses he shall kill the one having killed. And one witness shall not answer against a person to die.
And you shall not take a ransom for a life of one having killed, who is wicked to die, for dying, he shall be put to death.
And you shall not take a ransom to flee to the city of his refuge, to return to dwell in the land until the death of the priest.

And you shall not pollute the land in which you are, for the blood, it pollutes the land, and atonement for the land shall not be made for the blood that was poured out in it, except by the blood of the one pouring it out.
And you shall not make unclean the land in which you are dwelling, in the midst of which I am dwelling, for I, Yahweh, am dwelling in the midst of the sons of Israel.’”

And the heads of the fathers for the clan of the sons of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, from the clans of the sons of Joseph, came near, and they spoke to the face of Moses and to the face of the leaders, the heads of the fathers for the sons of Israel.

And they said, “Yahweh commanded my lord to give the land in inheritance by lot to the sons of Israel, and my lord was commanded by Yahweh to give the inheritance of Zelophehad our brother to his daughters.

And they will be for wives to one from the sons of the tribes of the sons of Israel, and their inheritance will be taken away from the inheritance of our fathers, and it will be added upon the inheritance of the tribe that they will be for them. And from the lot of our inheritance it will be taken away.

And if the Jubilee is for the sons of Israel, then their inheritance will be added upon the inheritance of the tribe that they will be for them, and from the inheritance of the tribe of our fathers their inheritance will be taken away.”
And Moses commanded the sons of Israel upon the mouth of Yahweh, saying, “The tribe of the sons of Joseph is speaking rightly.

This is the word that Yahweh has commanded for the daughters of Zelophehad, saying, ‘To the good in their eyes they will be for wives, only to the clan of the tribe of their father they will be for wives.’
And an inheritance for the sons of Israel shall not go around from tribe to tribe, for a man in the inheritance of the tribe of his fathers, the sons of Israel shall cling.

And every daughter possessing an inheritance from the tribes of the sons of Israel shall be for a wife to one from the clan of the tribe of her father, so that the sons of Israel will possess, a man the inheritance of his fathers.
And an inheritance shall not go around from a tribe to another tribe, for a man in his inheritance, the tribes of the sons of Israel will cling.”
Just as Yahweh commanded Moses, so the daughters of Zelophehad did.
And Mahlah, Tirzah, and Hoglah, and Milcah, and Noah, the daughters of Zelophehad, were to the sons of their uncles for wives.
From the clans of the sons of Manasseh, the son of Joseph, they were for wives, and their inheritance was upon the tribe of the clan of their father.
These are the commandments and the ordinances that Yahweh commanded in the hand of Moses to the sons of Israel in the plains of Moab beside the Jordan at Jericho.
